points.title: Ports and export hubs
points.note: Ports that export minerals or fuels, with each commodity's form, capacity, source and destination as USGS records them; port data mostly from the NGA World Port Index (public domain).
points.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey (2021), Compilation of Geospatial Data (GIS) for the Mineral Industries and Related Infrastructure of Africa, doi:10.5066/P97EQWXP

points.title: Mines and mineral facilities
points.withheld_reason: stated source names SNL, a commercial database
points.note: Mines, plants and other mineral facilities; capacity is a facility's stated capacity, not its output.
points.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey (2021), Compilation of Geospatial Data (GIS) for the Mineral Industries and Related Infrastructure of Africa, doi:10.5066/P97EQWXP

points.title: Mineral deposits
points.note: Major known deposits, from USGS's own compilations.
points.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey (2021), Compilation of Geospatial Data (GIS) for the Mineral Industries and Related Infrastructure of Africa, doi:10.5066/P97EQWXP

points.title: Exploration sites
points.note: Exploration projects, from USGS's World Minerals Exploration Database.
points.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey (2021), Compilation of Geospatial Data (GIS) for the Mineral Industries and Related Infrastructure of Africa, doi:10.5066/P97EQWXP

lines.title: Railways
lines.note: Every published class kept: railway and narrow-gauge railway.
lines.licence: ODbL 1.0 (share-alike: the derived tiles are published under ODbL)

lines.title: Major roads
lines.note: OpenStreetMap's road classes as published, motorway to secondary. No open source publishes axle loads, so the map shows the publisher's class, never a heavy-truck network of our own.
lines.licence: ODbL 1.0 (share-alike: the derived tiles are published under ODbL)

lines.title: Electricity grid
lines.note: Existing, planned and under-construction lines by voltage, as the World Bank compiled them in 2017; completeness varies widely by country.
lines.licence: CC BY 4.0 (the lines from OpenStreetMap keep ODbL)
lines.attribution: World Bank Group (2017), Africa Electricity Transmission and Distribution Grid Map (C. Arderne)
